Package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.datastore.parquetfile.footer

Class ThriftCompactReader

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.datastore.parquetfile.footer.ThriftCompactReader
public class ThriftCompactReader extends Object
ThriftCompactReader decodes a structure that has been serialized using the Apache Thrift compact protocol. This is the encoding used for all the metadata structures in an Apache Parquet file.

The reader is deliberately generic. It does not know the definition of the structure it is decoding, and so it returns each structure as a map from the field's identifier to its value. The value is one of:
  • Boolean - for a boolean field;
  • Long - for any of the integer fields (i8, i16, i32, i64);
  • Double - for a double field;
  • byte[] - for a binary or string field;
  • List - for a list or set field;
  • Map - for either a nested structure (keyed by field identifier) or a map field.
Working this way means that fields added by newer versions of the Parquet format are read, and then ignored by the caller, rather than causing a failure. It also means that there is no need for the Thrift libraries, or code generated from the Parquet thrift definition.
